acceptance: Per-platform unit tests (fake drivers): no OPTIMIZE/ANALYZE/VACUUM/ZORDER/RESUME RECLUSTER executes during apply_unified_tuning; each executes after its table's load, recorded with phase post_load.
Bundle exposes post-load maintenance time separately from data_loading time (schema/docs updated).
context: Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan task P2.4 (A1.5; plan review F12 extended the call-site list).
description:
## Problem
Maintenance and layout ops run **before** data is loaded, inside `apply_unified_tuning`:
- ClickHouse `OPTIMIZE … FINAL` (`clickhouse/tuning.py:319-345`; its only caller is `tuning.py:335`);
- Redshift `ANALYZE`/`VACUUM` (`redshift.py:2612-2710`);
- Databricks `_apply_delta_optimize(..., phase="pre_load")` (`databricks/adapter.py:3609`);
- Snowflake `RESUME RECLUSTER`.

So they act on empty tables.

## Change
- Add `PlatformAdapter.apply_post_load_tunings(table_name, effective_config, connection)`.
- Call it after each table load, next to every existing `apply_ctas_sort` call site:
  - `DataLoader.load` (`platforms/base/data_loading.py:2788-2791`);
  - Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Athena, Synapse, ClickHouse Cloud, MotherDuck;
  - DataFusion (`datafusion.py:861`);
  - DuckDB's `apply_ctas_sort` override (`duckdb.py:1057`).
- Move the ops listed above into it.
- Record each through the recording connection with phase `post_load`. Use physical names from `tuning-physical-identifier-resolution-20261001`.
- Make ClickHouse `OPTIMIZE` opt-in (expensive at scale).
- Time post-load maintenance as its own phase so the measured load time stays comparable.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Ordering per table: load → CTAS sort (if any) → post-load ops.
- Failures are recorded as failed and never break the run.

## Do not
- Do not run maintenance inside the timed load window without reporting it separately.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
